title: Guide in the Darkness
description: Location: Inside the underground ruins Solution: Find your way into the underground ruins by either dropping through [the broken stone floor in the ruins](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=943114) on the side of the road, or by finding [the ruins entrance in the rocks](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=943113) down the cliff from the road Related Challenge: Wandering Footsteps Secret Places Reward: - Abyss Artifact

title: Dragon's Stone Chamber Ruins
description: Location: Inside the [Dragon Stone Chamber](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=545433) Solution: Check the map mural on the wall - notice the 3 red arrows pointing to different locations in the region. Each location matches a painted pattern shown on the 3 wheels in the depression below. Turn each of the 3 pattern wheels to match the orientations of the paintings in the world: - [Dragon's Stone Chamber Mural 1](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=546888#L) - [Dragon's Stone Chamber Mural 2](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=546890#L) - [Dragon's Stone Chamber Mural 3](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=546892#L) Related Challenge: The Thread in the Forest Ancient Ruins Reward: - Abyss Artifact x1 - Memories of Abundance x1

title: Abyss Cresset in the Steel Mountains
description: Location: In the valley with the Pororin decorations, behind a sealed door. Solution: Using the mallet nearby, ring the bells in the correct order as stated on the notice board to the left of the bells (left to right/top to bottom). When done correctly the Cresset will be revealed Related Challenge: The Mystery in the Forest Puzzles Reward: - Abyss Artifact x1

title: Abyss Cresset of the Trembling Woods
description: Location: Look for a puzzle with a big circular disk in the cliff face and 3 crank wheels on the ground, guarded by [2 Bears](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=546832). Solution: Turn the wheels so that the images in the disk all line up (the left-side wheel must be pierced with your sword to be rotated), and the Cresset will be revealed below Related Challenge: The Mystery in the Forest Puzzles Reward: - Abyss Artifact x1

title: Abyss Cresset of the Hunter's Cabin
description: Location: Inside of the small stone crypt at the top of the stone stairs in the graveyard. Solution: Ensure that all lanterns are lit in the graveyard and the crypt will open Related Challenge: The Mystery in the Forest Puzzles Reward: - Abyss Artifact x1

title: Abyss Cresset of Drakesfall Gorge
description: Location: In the [Ancient Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=546390) at the end of the walkway lined with the stone statues Solution: Stand on the rectangular stone platform at the beginning of the walkway, opposite the unpowered Cresset, to activate the challenge. You'll need to traverse the walkway without the big statue at the end seeing you. Quickly run while the statue is not looking, but stand still when the statue looks towards you. Alternatively, use Axiom Force Aerial Maneuver to leap across the heads of the statues. Reaching the base of the big statue at the end should unlock the Cresset Related Challenge: The Mystery in the Forest Puzzles Reward: - Abyss Artifact x1

title: Abyss Cresset of Duskwood
description: Location: Ancient Ruins, south of the river. Solution: Fill in the puzzle with the provided stone. Don't move anything else on the board. Related Challenge: The Mystery in the Forest - Puzzles Reward: - Abyss Artifact

title: Where Sky Meets Earth
description: Location: Atop the Galepully in Trembling Gorge, the towering large rock with structures leading up. Solution: Scale the mountain up to the plateau. Related Challenge: Where Sky Meets Earth Reward: - Abyss Artifact

title: Halssius Conflux Ruins
description: Location: Southeast of the St. Halssius's House of Healing Solution: Use Nature's Grasp to move the fallen pillars on the ground. Then match the dial with the object(s) as indicated by the laser(s). Stab into the large handle to move the dial. Related Challenge: The Thread in the Forest Ancient Ruins Reward: - Abyss Artifact

title: Arboria Forest Ruins
description: Location: Alongside some cliffs amongst some stone ruins near the Hills of No Return Solution: Use a Stab attack to plunge your sword into each fountainhead and turn them until they all flow into the center. After the fountain fills up and the waterwheel begins to turn, the challenge will complete Related Challenge: The Thread in the Forest Ancient Ruins Reward: - Abyss Artifact

title: Ancient Rift Maze
description: Location: On the far west side, at the bottom of The Ancient Rift Solution: Obtain all 3 Engraved Stones and insert them into the 3 holes to unlock the Cresset - [Engraved Stone](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=552084#L) - [Engraved Stone](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=552085#L) - [Engraved Stone](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=552086#L) Related Challenge: Winding Paths Mazes Reward: - Abyss Artifact - [Rivenheim Cloth Armor](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=940387)

title: Duskwood Hill Ruins
description: Location: In the ruins down from the road Solution: Use Blinding Flash or fire to burn vines off of the five pillars and the pedestal near the Cresset. Then use the Stab skill to insert your sword into the slots on the pedestal. While the sword is inserted, move the pedestal clockwise or counter-clockwise to move the 5 pillars behind the Cresset until all are aligned and lit yellow. The different holes on the pedestal control different pillars. All pillars will light blue when completed. Related Challenge: The Thread in the Forest Ancient Ruins Reward: - Abyss Artifact

description: Location: - Hidden Chamber of Wisdom Solution: Follow the markers on the map provided in the chamber to find 4 murals, then hit those murals in the chamber with force palm - [Hidden Chamber Of Wisdom Mural I](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=555054) - [Hidden Chamber of Wisdom Mural II](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=555053) - [Hidden Chamber of Wisdom Mural III](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=555052) - [Hidden Chamber of Wisdom Mural IV](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=555266) Murals to hit: - Lightning (top right) - Wind (top middle) - Water (middle left) - Fire (bottom left) Related Challenge: The Thread in the Forest > Hidden Chamber of Wisdom Ruins Reward: - [Memories of the Northern Winds](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=555267) - Abyss Artifact x1 - Memory of Tide x1

title: Five Finger Mountain Valley Ruins Puzzle
description: Location: In the northwest of Pailune Solution: Push each stone block forward and jump on top to shoot each revealed statue with your bow until they display the correct face. The correct statue combinations are: - *Left statue:* Man holding an Axe. - *Middle statue:* Man holding a Sword. - *Right statue:* Man holding a Shield. TIP: The closer to the centre you shoot the statues, the less it rotates (The puzzle needs them to be almost perfectly rotated). The statues will glow blue when they are correctly aligned. Related Challenge: The Thread in the Forest Reward: - Abyss Artifact

title: Deepfog Basin Everfrost Ruins Abyss Cresset
description: Location: The ancient ruins just within the tree line in Deepfrog Basin. Solution: Stab your sword into the rotating wheel and align the 5 pillars to the same height as the far left pillar to unlock. Pillars will glow when at correct height. Related Challenge: Deepfrog Basin Everfrost Ruins Reward: - Abyss Artifact

title: Spire of Insight
description: How to Enter: Burn away the thorny vines blocking the doorway with Blinding Flash. Place a _Small Pebble_ in the receptacle to open the door How to Ascend: Place the correct items in the golden bowl on the platform in front of the book to raise the elevator. Look for items that you can _Carry_ - use the text as well as the pictures in the book for clues: - First Section: - Gravestone - Second Section: - Telescope - Pen Tip - Third Section: - Celestial - Sun Dial - Small Rotating Globe Abyss Connection: [Chaos Forest](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=552237)

title: Spire of Ringing Truth
description: How to Enter: Through the front door How to Ascend: Use any means necessary to climb to the top of the tower and shoot down the big bell from its broken supports. Dive into the hole that it makes below, where you must defeat [Priscus the Ancient](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=545764) before progressing to the Abyss Abyss Connection: [Ether Rest](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=550192)

title: Spire of the Stars
description: How to Enter: Entry requires Spire of Stars Key, given during main quest [Spire of the Stars](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=545859) How to Ascend: Solve the puzzle by obtaining the keys, placing them in their necessary receptacles, then moving the symbols to their correct positions by hanging on them to pull them down Abyss Connection: [Sanctorum of Insight](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=550191#L)

title: Spire of Frost
description: How to Enter: Heavy attack the frozen lantern outside the entrance, then light it and the door to the Spire will open How to Ascend: Having high Ice Resistance will help. Ascend the Spire by any means necessary - when the stairs are blocked inside, climb the stairs outside, and vice versa. De-ice and light all 7 lanterns along the way. While exposed to the ice, you will slowly take damage. While next to a lantern, you will not take damage. Abyss Connection: [Passage of Malice](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=551235)

title: Spire of Soaring
description: Requires main quest progression to reach the top. How to Enter: Climb up the outside of the tower until you reach a platform with a grate leading into the tower. Alternatively, enter from below the tower via the [Spire of Soaring Tunnels](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=552459) How to Ascend: Solve the puzzles on the walls to direct the electricity into the circuits. Use Axiom Force to turn the square pieces and the large circular piece to direct the flow.

title: Spire of Clockwork
description: How to Enter: Requires the [Spire of Clockwork Key](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=560394), obtained near the end of Chapter 8 How to Ascend: Hang on the handles to pull them down and power the gears going up the spire. Take the elevator outside the spire up to the top Abyss Connection: [Riddle Square](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=564667)

title: Jijeong Temple Pagoda
description: How to Enter: Requires progression of Chapter 9: [Face the Inner Self](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=546422) How to Ascend: Traverse to the top of the mountain and enter Abyss Connection: [Ascetic's Rest](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=550190)

title: Gate to Advancement
description: How to Enter: Can be accessed from ground level, or above How to Ascend: Requires progression of faction quest [Old Research Journal](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=563325). Activate and utilize the teleporter inside the Spire by aligning the symbols so that the lines that make up the symbols are continuous Abyss Connection: [Skypillar Archipelago](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=566123)

title: Spire of the Sun
description: How to Enter: May require main quest progression into Chapter 9. Align the mirrors, at the edge of the cliff outside the Spire, on the eastern side, so that the laser is projected into the crystal. title: Well
description: Well localizado em South Sea of Pywel.

title: Abyss Artifact
description: Location: On the table inside the hut surrounded by traps at [Meshley Trapsmith](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=545725). Get inside via the hole in the wall above the door Related Quest: [The Missing Seal](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=545970)

title: Secret Garden
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Slot the logic chip into the socket - Manipulate the laser emitters with Axiom Force - Align the lasers to activate the crystal orbs

title: Vault of Vengeance
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Use Axiom Force to move the 2 blocks to deactivate the forcefield - Quickly fire 2 arrows at the yellow targets to open the vault door - Using Focused Shot, mark all 4 targets in the vault, then hit them all simultaneously - Take the [Golden Sword](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=552242) and descend - Dodge past the lasers, then insert the logic chip into the socket - Insert the battery into the socket, Force Palm the circular mechanism, and retrieve the Artifact

title: Courtyard of Precision
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Use Focused Shot to hit multiple targets simultaneously - While in the air, it's easiest to take aim while ascending - It may also be possible to hit the targets while standing on the floating ring

title: Altar of Solitude
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - All 4 logic chips need to be set into their sockets - 2 are underground - use the electric block to flip the floor - Use a jumping downward Force Palm to set the chips - Use Axiom Force to pull out and manipulate the chips

title: Sanctorum of Insight
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Traverse the platforms

title: Ice Cradle
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Place the battery cell in its socket in the cave below - Use Blinding Light to repeat the melody in the cave below

title: Twisted Thicketway
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Defeat Kutum - Then Force Palm the circular mechanism high up on the structure

title: Ether Fragment
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Repair and ride the [Ether Fragment Flying Platform](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=554205) up to the Abyss - Force Palm the circular switch on the ground

title: Crescent Skybridge
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Align the lasers by controlling the yellow orbs with Axiom Force - Ensure that all conduits are connected

title: Chaos Forest
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Burn away all vines you see - Dunk the CPU on fire in the water, then socket it - On the other side, open the door with Nature's Grasp - Socket the CPU inside - Carry and place the block(s) to keep the door open, completing the circuit - Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

title: Roots of Truth
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Find and extract the 2 CPU's - maneuver them through the smaller rectangular holes as necessary - Socket both CPU's, then Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

title: Precipice of Truth
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Kill all laser turrets with your Axiom Force - pick up their Power Cores with your [Kuku Pot](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=545828) - Use the Power Cores to remove the forcefield barriers - Pull the power cell and the 2 CPU's from behind their respective forcefields and deposit them into their respective sockets - Use the fans to fly up to and Force Palm the circular switch

title: Root's End
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Crouch and Force Palm the bronze grate in the middle of the water area - Drop/float through the shaft avoiding the lasers - Connect the rectangular power cell, then teleport back up - Connect the second rectangular power cell, then Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

title: Ether Rest
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Fly to and climb up the big rotating structure until you can climb inside - Use Axiom Force to control the bronze cylindrical grates - rotate the grates until you can enter - Use Nature's Grasp on the stone column with the hole in the middle to expose an Axiom Force control point and rotate the room to exit - Ride the fans all the way to the top, collecting a power core on the way up - Place the power core on the pedestal to open the door - Ride the horizontal fan across to the Force Palm switch and the Artifact

title: Frostbitten Paradise
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Place the laser cube in front of the orange crystal deactivate the forcefield - Stand on the ground plate to open the floor panel - then drop inside - Connect the rectangular power cell - Power other orange crystal with the laser cube to open the door to the side of the moving platform - In the side room - power the bigger crystals to open the forcefield - Maneuver the rectangular power cell through the hole and slot it into its socket - Take the teleporter, in the same room, back up - Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

title: Path of Trials
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Climb up to the CPU, taking heed of the damaging cold - get warm from the lanterns scattered around - From the forcefield near the CPU, follow the cable down to an electric node - Pull the battery from its socket to deactivate the forcefield - Grab then dunk the CPU in the lava in the structure below, to remove the frost affecting it - Socket the CPU - Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

title: Sanctorum of Darkness
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Force Palm the bronze grate, below the nexus, while holding on to it - Pull the CPU from the socket in the room on the other side - Pull the CPU out the hole above, then socket it on the ground below - Align the lasers to the orange crystals using Axiom Force - Force Palm the switch to complete the puzzle

title: Loop of Life
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Socket one of each of the 3 CPU's into the 3 big floating rings as necessary - Socket the 2nd CPU into the temporary socket to remove the forcefield and retrieve the 3rd CPU - Then remove the 2nd CPU and socket it in the ring - Force Palm the circle switch while holding onto the wall

title: Tree of Slumber
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Stab into the center stone cylinder in the middle of the lava to move the smaller surrounding cylinders - Each of the 4 Stab points on the center cylinder move different small cylinders - Align all 5 cylinders so that they light up yellow - Force Palm the circle switch after the lava drains

title: Skyloop Bridge
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Fly through the first ring with the blue light - Then repair all 3 rings so that they look like the first one, covered in blue lights - Control the yellow pillars with Axiom Force - operating a pillar will move the floating platform to it - Position the other floating platforms to be able to move the broken ring pieces - all using Axiom Force - Force Palm the circle switch after all 4 rings are lit up

title: Passage of Malice
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Use Axiom Force to move the laser to activate the crystal, opening the floor - Down below, use Axiom Force to control the giant cubes with yellow lights - Flip the cubes to make a groove to slide the lasers - Situate the lasers to activate the crystals - In the room beyond - socket the power cell, then Force Palm the circular switch

title: Tomb of Perdition
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Rotate the big box with bronze grates with Axiom Force to gain access to either side - Socket the CPU and the power cell on either side - Socket the second power cell in the socket near the circular switch - Force Palm the circular switch

title: Desert Fragment
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Use Axiom Force to manipulate the cubes - Turn the cubes so that all 3 lasers activate all 3 crystals

title: Cradle of Truth
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Dunk the fire-affected CPU into the water, then socket it - Move the other CPU from the center platform to the far side and socket it - Avoid the lasers via flying, jumping, ducking etc. - Force Palm the circular switch

title: Scholars Carrying Abyss Artifacts
description: Location: Scholars throughout the Scholastone campus have a chance to carry Abyss Artifacts that can be pickpocketed

title: Faded Abyss Artifact
description: Location: On the altar in the room at the end of the corridor - to the left of the big circle door, within the [Cloister of Enlightenment](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=549483)

title: Ascetic's Rest
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Use Nature's Snare to activate the spinning wind device in the water - Follow the stairs to a dead end with a pool of water - Force Palm the wall - Retrieve the CPU from the room below the spinning wind device - Socket the CPU and Force Palm the circular switch

title: Path of Serpents
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Redirect the energy to the two pathways on the left and right - Use the Axiom Force to rotate the tiles - Use the Lantern to reveal the hidden circuit pathways on the rotating tiles

title: Crossroads of Uncertainty
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Use Axiom Force on the small yellow circles to power the rings and fans - The power will die after an unspecified time limit - Fly through the rings after they're activated - Bring the power all the way to the end opposite the start - Force Palm the vertical circular switch

title: Riddle Square
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Axiom Force the yellow button to start the trial - Fly through all blue rings within the time limit - the yellow lines encircling the rings denote time remaining - Use fans for the majority of movement

title: Origin of Thoughts
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Ascend the rings through use of fans - Halfway up, socket the power cell to power the fans - At the top, Axiom Force the yellow button to control the mechanism - Control rings so that the little pop outs on each ring align with the 3 connection points - Drop down to the bottom through the hole in the middle of the ring and Force Palm circular switch

title: Forgotten Altar
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Place the lose sphere to the right of the nexus into its slot to restore power - Use the fans to get to the top of the mechanism in the middle - Land in the middle of the mechanism and use Nature's Snare to stop it spinning - Descend to the middle of the island and use Force Palm on a revolving door to enter the box - Force Palm the circular switch to complete the puzzle

title: Disconnected Truth
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Connect the disconnected conduit and ride up the center platform - Light up the three circles by following their cables to a CPU socket - Look for a CPU directly above the center platform you arrive on - One CPU must be removed and socketed in the correct location - Reconnect all conduits as necessary - Activate the yellow circles with Axiom Force, turning them blue - Force Palm the circular switch for completion

title: Dimensional Labyrinth
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Use Force Palm while Resisting to spin the revolving doors to complete the circuits as necessary - Connect the 2 power cells - One power cell is inside - push it out through the holes in the wall - Force Palm the circular switch for completion

title: Sanctum of Transcendence
description: Challenge: Restoration - The Abyss Hints to Progress: - Use [Focused Force Palm](https://mapgenie.io/crimson-desert/maps/pywel?locationIds=551548) to destroy the Bismuth Barriers - Socket the CPU - Force Palm the circular switch for completion

title: Monolith Crown
